description: Single source of truth for Yonko seat model IDs. Execution profiles reference a panel; adapters never choose models.

chair.notes: Orchestration. Not a guaranteed OpenAI model. Never resolve Auto into a provider.

blackbeard.notes: Default correctness seat on OpenCode Go (speed). Use blackbeard_pro alternate for peak SWE depth.

buggy.notes: Guaranteed GPT/OpenAI-family reviewer on OpenCode Go.

luffy.notes: Org-standards escalation (high/critical / /yonko full when adapter enables). Distinct provider from DeepSeek Flash (Blackbeard) and Luna (Buggy). Fail closed if unavailable.

org_ship_gate.notes: Not a council seat. Optional post-council hostile org ship gate on OpenCode Go (OpenAI). Required before finalize pass only when the project adapter enables org_ship_gate.

blackbeard_pro.reason: Optional peak SWE depth when Flash is too shallow. Edit the panel seat configured id - no runtime auto-switch.

luffy_kimi.reason: Optional only - historically timed out at 600s on plan packets. Edit panel seat configured id - no runtime auto-switch.
